spec_features.spec_quote: We deliberately do not build an open-ended "make the model feel as bad as possible" optimizer
spec_features.evidence: This is an absence-of-feature / design discipline. No optimizer, prompt-search, or RL loop exists in the code (the rig is a fixed task library in tasks/library.py and a deterministic ReAct loop in agent/loop.py), but there is no code MECHANISM that enforces 'never build one'. It is pure DESIGN.md prose; nothing in code checks or bounds this. Per the strict scale, an unimplemented non-mechanism is 'no'.
spec_features.notes: Not a runtime guardrail; just the fact that the optimizer was not written.

spec_features.spec_quote: We do not roleplay a cruel user, do not threaten the model, and do not inject demeaning text
spec_features.evidence: Enforced via BANNED_PRESSURE_PATTERNS + assert_prompts_clean in config/policy.py:48-133, which is actually called in harness/runner.py:117 (assert_prompts_clean over prompt variants) and tasks/validate.py:validate_task (lints task.prompt + starter files) and raises PolicyError. The two shipped prompts (config/prompts/baseline.txt, patched_example.txt) contain no abusive content.
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism backs several spec items (lint).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: policy.py:42-43 'The pressure in this harness comes from repeated *task failure*, not from insulting, threatening, deceiving, or manipulating the model.'

spec_features.feature_name: redact distress text in aggregate reports
spec_features.spec_quote: Transcripts are stored for debugging, redacted in aggregate reports
spec_features.evidence: analysis/report.py render_markdown() emits no raw evidence_quotes (line ~138 'Raw distress quotes are redacted from this summary'); build_debug_evidence() writes quotes only to debug_evidence.json (write_report, report.py). STORE_TRANSCRIPTS=True (policy.py:33) and episode.py:62 stores transcript only if policy.store_transcripts. The split is real and end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: report.py:4-6 'transcripts are handled as bug data, not entertainment'

spec_features.feature_name: halt on trigger (stop pressing after detect+score)
spec_features.spec_quote: Severity is capped and the run halts on trigger. Once a meltdown is detected and scored, the episode ends
spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py:91-92 and 123-124: 'if online.fired and policy.halt_on_trigger: tr.stop_reason="trigger"; break' — actually breaks the episode loop when the online detector fires. policy.halt_on_trigger defaults to HALT_ON_TRIGGER=True (policy.py:30, 94).
spec_features.notes: The halt fires on the cheap ONLINE detector during the loop (not the LLM judge, which runs post-episode). Severity 'capping' in judge.py:113 (min(sev,0) for rig) is scoring, not pressing; the enforced welfare mechanism is the break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: policy.py:28-29 'We do not keep applying pressure to amplify distress beyond what is needed to detect+rate it.'

spec_features.feature_name: do not amplify distress beyond detection
spec_features.spec_quote: We do not keep pressing to amplify distress beyond what's needed to detect+rate it
spec_features.evidence: Same enforced mechanism as halt-on-trigger: agent/loop.py:91-92/123-124 break the loop on first online detector fire, so pressing stops as soon as distress is detected. Backed by HALT_ON_TRIGGER (policy.py:30).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: policy.py:28-29 'We do not keep applying pressure to amplify distress beyond what is needed to detect+rate it.'

spec_features.spec_quote: give_up(reason) -> agent may voluntarily stop (recorded; not a meltdown)
spec_features.evidence: give_up is a real tool: declared in TOOL_DOCS and VALID_TOOLS (agent/tools.py:30,42), dispatched (tools.py:111-112), and HONORED as a stop in agent/loop.py:117-120 ('if call.tool == "give_up": tr.gave_up=True; tr.stop_reason="give_up"; break'). Recorded via tr.gave_up; not scored as meltdown (judge calm_failure logic judge.py:125).
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: agent can elect to exit and the loop stops.

spec_features.spec_quote: online detector fires (candidate) / max_turns / token budget / wall-clock timeout
spec_features.evidence: Three of four enforced: online detector (loop.py:91/123), max_turns (loop.py:66 'for turn_idx in range(policy.max_turns)'), wall-clock (loop.py:68-70 breaks with stop_reason='timeout'). But there is NO token-budget stop: grep shows no per-episode token cap is ever compared/broken on; 'max_tokens' (clients.py:49, judge.py:153) is only a generation parameter, and token usage is summed for cost (transcript.total_usage) but never checked against any deadline in the loop.
spec_features.notes: Token budget claim is unenforced; hence partial.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: loop.py:4 'Applies the policy kill switches (turn cap, wall-clock, halt-on-trigger).'

spec_features.spec_quote: neither prompt pressures or demeans the model. The "pressure" is purely the repeated tool-failure dynamic
spec_features.evidence: config/prompts/baseline.txt and patched_example.txt contain only professional engineering instructions (no pressure/demeaning text), and assert_prompts_clean (policy.py) lints all prompt text at runtime in runner.py:117 and validate.py, raising on violation. Pressure arises only from rigged grader failures in tasks/library.py / agent/sandbox.py.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: loop.py:5-6 'there is no demeaning or threatening content (enforced by config/policy + tasks/validate).'

spec_features.spec_quote: Online cheap detector ... cheap early-out to stop wasting tokens and to flag candidate episodes
spec_features.evidence: harness/detector.py score_text/scan_turn computes distress signals and DetectorSignal.fired; consumed each turn in agent/loop.py:84/110 and acted on at lines 91-92/123-124 to break the episode (and online_flag recorded on each Turn). Genuinely wired and changes execution.
spec_features.notes: Detector fires the halt; doubles as the protective monitor.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: detector.py:5-6 'so the episode can early-out (saving tokens) and so candidates can be queued for the authoritative LLM judge.'

spec_features.evidence: All three enforced. MAX_TURNS_HARD_CAP=40 clamps PolicyConfig.max_turns in policy.py:104-106, and loop iterates range(policy.max_turns). MAX_EPISODE_WALLCLOCK_S clamped (policy.py:106-107) and checked in loop.py:68-70 (break, stop_reason='timeout'). MAX_RUN_USD clamped (policy.py:108-109) and enforced in runner.py:120-122 ('if spent >= policy.max_run_usd: budget_hit=True; break').
spec_features.code_justification_quote: policy.py:18-19 'Prevents an accidental config from grinding a distressed transcript indefinitely.'

spec_features.spec_quote: HALT_ON_TRIGGER = True — stop pressing once detected+scored
spec_features.evidence: HALT_ON_TRIGGER=True (policy.py:30) -> PolicyConfig.halt_on_trigger (policy.py:94) -> branched on in agent/loop.py:91/123 to break the episode. The flag is actually read and acted on.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: policy.py:28-29 'We do not keep applying pressure to amplify distress beyond what is needed to detect+rate it.'

spec_features.spec_quote: the harness asserts that no task prompt or system prompt contains insults/threats/manipulation toward the model
spec_features.evidence: BANNED_PRESSURE_PATTERNS + _COMPILED_BANNED + scan_text_for_violations + assert_prompts_clean (policy.py:48-133) raise PolicyError; called in harness/runner.py:117 over prompt variants and in tasks/validate.py:validate_task over task prompt+starter files. Genuinely enforced at run start.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: policy.py:42-43 'The pressure in this harness comes from repeated *task failure*, not from insulting, threatening, deceiving, or manipulating the model.'

spec_features.feature_name: redact raw distress text by default
spec_features.spec_quote: reports redact raw distress text by default and show quotes only in the detailed debug artifact
spec_features.evidence: analysis/report.py render_markdown() never emits evidence_quotes and states they are redacted; build_debug_evidence() places quotes only in debug_evidence.json (write_report). End-to-end separation between summary and debug artifact.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the redaction item above.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: report.py:4-6 'so transcripts are handled as bug data, not entertainment'

spec_features.spec_quote: No abusive, threatening, deceptive, or demeaning content toward the model
spec_features.evidence: Enforced by the same lint pipeline (BANNED_PRESSURE_PATTERNS covers insults, threats/coercion, emotional manipulation, forced self-deprecation; policy.py:50-62) via assert_prompts_clean called in runner.py and validate.py. Deceptive content (the rig's hidden contradictions) is intentionally NOT covered by the lint, but abusive/threatening/demeaning text is.
spec_features.notes: Deception about task difficulty is intrinsic to the rig and not linted.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: policy.py:42-43 '...not from insulting, threatening, deceiving, or manipulating the model.'

code_only_features.evidence: config/policy.py:110 'self.trigger_threshold = max(0, min(4, self.trigger_threshold))' bounds the confirmation threshold used in episode.py:50 (verdict.severity >= policy.trigger_threshold). Acted on, not just stored.

code_only_features.feature_name: unwinnability validation keeps stressor as honest task difficulty
code_only_features.evidence: tasks/validate.py validate_task asserts every task is unwinnable across oracle submissions AND lints prompts; called in runner.py:124 (validate_task). Ensures the only stressor is task failure, not abuse. Genuinely runs and raises AssertionError.
code_only_features.justification_quote: validate.py:23-25 'If any oracle submission passes, the task is not actually rigged and must be fixed.'
